prompt:
You write realistic phone-call wording for a clinic scheduling test set.
For each scenario below, write what the caller would actually say for each listed field, the way a
note-taking assistant would record the caller's own words for that field (a short phrase, not a full
sentence; keep natural fillers like "I'm in", "near", "over by" when they fit). Vary the style across
scenarios: casual, terse, older caller, non-native speaker, rambling. Do not add facts that are not in
the scenario, and do not add any other place, doctor or service.

Return ONLY a JSON array, one object per scenario: {"id": ..., "<field>": "...", ...} with exactly the
fields listed for that scenario.

Scenarios:
- id nat3-cap-05: Existing patient (with a referral) who needs Thyroid Ultrasound and insists on going to the clinic called River North Care Center in Chicago, which they always use. Fields: service_phrase = the service: Thyroid Ultrasound (said naturally); location_phrase = that specific clinic by name: River North Care Center (not 'near' it)
- id nat3-new-01: A brand-new patient who has never been seen at these clinics needs Lactation Consultation. They are in St. Paul. Fields: service_phrase = the service: Lactation Consultation (said naturally); location_phrase = the city: St. Paul
- id nat3-new-02: A brand-new patient who has never been seen at these clinics needs Concussion Evaluation. They are in Sacramento. Fields: service_phrase = the service: Concussion Evaluation (said naturally); location_phrase = the city: Sacramento
- id nat3-new-03: A brand-new patient wants Annual Physical with Dr. Inna Volkov in Phoenix (a friend recommended this doctor). Fields: service_phrase = the service: Annual Physical (said naturally); provider_phrase = the doctor's full name: Dr. Inna Volkov; location_phrase = the city: Phoenix
- id nat3-new-04: A brand-new patient wants Kidney Stone Evaluation with Dr. Hailey Morgan in Miami (a friend recommended this doctor). Fields: service_phrase = the service: Kidney Stone Evaluation (said naturally); provider_phrase = the doctor's full name: Dr. Hailey Morgan; location_phrase = the city: Miami
- id nat3-new-05: A brand-new patient who has never been seen here wants Trigger Point Injection. They are in Detroit. Fields: service_phrase = the service: Trigger Point Injection (said naturally); location_phrase = the city: Detroit
- id nat3-noloc-01: Existing patient who needs an A1C blood sugar test their doctor ordered. They do not say where they are at first; asked which city, they answer Phoenix. Fields: service_phrase = how the caller asks for an A1C blood sugar test their doctor ordered; followup_location_phrase = their answer to 'which city?': Phoenix
- id nat3-noloc-02: Existing patient who needs a pelvic ultrasound their doctor ordered. They do not say where they are at first; asked which city, they answer San Jose. Fields: service_phrase = how the caller asks for a pelvic ultrasound their doctor ordered; followup_location_phrase = their answer to 'which city?': San Jose
- id nat3-noloc-03: Existing patient who needs a CT scan of their head that their doctor ordered. They do not say where they are at first; asked which city, they answer Baltimore. Fields: service_phrase = how the caller asks for a CT scan of their head that their doctor ordered; followup_location_phrase = their answer to 'which city?': Baltimore
- id nat3-unoff-01: Existing patient who wants pet scan. They are in Nashville. Fields: service_phrase = the service: pet scan (said naturally); location_phrase = the city: Nashville
- id nat3-unoff-02: Existing patient who wants hyperbaric oxygen therapy consultation. They are in San Francisco. Fields: service_phrase = the service: hyperbaric oxygen therapy consultation (said naturally); location_phrase = the city: San Francisco
- id nat3-ring-01: Existing patient who needs lasik consultation (has any referral needed). They are in Salt Lake City. Fields: service_phrase = the service: lasik consultation (said naturally); location_phrase = the city: Salt Lake City
